activity.notes: The Institute of National Remembrance records that Witold Pilecki fought in Polish cavalry formations defending Poland in 1939. The Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial likewise describes his 1939 cavalry service before he and fellow officers established the Secret Polish Army. ATLAS therefore uses the source-backed 1939 military-service year as Pilecki's primary Activity under the already-established Second Polish Republic identity. His later Auschwitz resistance remains historical context, but is not encoded as a forbidden primary `opposes` relationship or as service to Germany.
